source_document: ICAO Doc 8126, Aeronautical Information Services Manual, 7th Edition (2022), Part III Appendix G "NOTAM Selection Criteria"
source_revision: Complete: all 13 NOTAM Selection Criteria categories of Doc 8126 Part III Appendix G (III-App G-4 to III-App G-104) transcribed and visually verified against rendered PDF pages at 220dpi (2026-08-15) -- Lighting Facilities (L), Movement and Landing Area (M), Facilities and Services (F), Communications and Surveillance (C), Instrument and Microwave Landing Systems (I), GNSS Services (G), Terminal and En-route Navigation (N), Airspace Organization (A), Air Traffic and VOLMET Services (S), Air Traffic Procedures (P), Airspace Restrictions (R), Navigation Warnings (W), Other Information (O), plus the standalone KK checklist code. During this pass, three pre-existing hand-curated values were found to not match the source document and were corrected: MR/LC purpose NB->NBO, MR/HW purpose NB->BO, MX/LC purpose M->BO (Doc 8126 III-App G-23, III-App G-26). The pre-existing FA/TT, FF/CG, RT/CA, and AF/TT values were all confirmed correct against the source and upgraded from HAND_CURATED to VERIFIED_VISUAL.
